architecture: language-independent PrintC structured-block emission (emitBlockSwitch on a hand-built production-shape BlockSwitch: BlockBasic originals + edges, BlockCopy mirrors via newBlockCopy/copymap/replaceUsingMap as buildCopy block.cc:1925-1938, JumpTable label/block2addr tables, grabCaseBasic+identifyInternal+addBlock as newBlockSwitch block.cc:1904-1919); no Funcdata, no Architecture
compiler_spec: none: the switch variable and return values are Constant-space varnodes with an int4 Datatype attached via new HighVariable (Rugra: v_type), so both sides render them through their constant paths

analysis_options.entrypoint: PrintC::emitBlockSwitch driven directly per case (Rugra: emit_block_graph on a graph whose sole top-level block is the BlockSwitch, dispatching to emit_structured_switch); no Action pipeline runs
analysis_options.prestate: per case: fresh head BlockBasic ending in BRANCHIND(const switch var 3, int4), case BlockBasics with 2-input RETURN(const value) bodies, edges head->case in label order, one optional f_defaultswitch_edge, one optional case->exit edge (isexit=true)
analysis_options.observation: two layers per case: (statement) every line normalized to switch(E) / verbatim case-label and default lines / body-statement kind (break/return/assign/other) with indentation preserved; (raw) full hex of the EmitNoMarkup byte stream

input_manifest.canonicalization: sha256 over the canonical input description above
cases: two_case_return: labels {0},{1} with RETURN-terminated bodies — label/body order, isexit=false (no breaks)
single_case_default: label {5} + default edge — KEYWORD_DEFAULT rendering (cc:3140-3145); the default edge carries a table entry because the default arm calls getLabel(casenum,0) unconditionally
multi_label_first: first case block reached by two table entries (labels {2,3}) — consecutive `case 2:`/`case 3:` lines before the shared body (the PRINTC-SWITCH-EMIT-0001 timing-defect detector)
break_exit_form: case 0 empty with an edge to the formal exit (isexit=true, not last) — the explicit `break;` of cc:3342-3345 between later cases

observation_schema.format: per case: '<name>=' followed by the summarized line stream (statement mode) or the hex of the raw byte stream (--raw mode)
observation_schema.normalization: switch header elided to switch(E) (the control expression is fixture data, not an observable of the emission path); case/default label lines verbatim; body statements reduced to kind with indentation preserved

observation.label_emission: MATCH: per-label tagLine + `case` + spaces(1) + pushConstant + `:` (cc:3146-3157) — label order, multi-label grouping (multi_label_first's consecutive `case 2:`/`case 3:`), and default rendering all byte-identical
observation.body_emission_timing: MATCH: bl2->emit(this) at cc:3339-3341 — the first case's label precedes its body and every body lands inside the switch (the A10 regression: DEAD-guarded emit_block_structured swallowed the absorbed case blocks; fixed by emit_switch_case_body dispatching per FlowBlock::emit with no dead guard)
observation.break_placement: MATCH: cc:3342-3345 isExit(i)&&i!=last — break_exit_form's case 0 gets `break;`, RETURN-terminated cases and the last label do not
observation.layout: MATCH: openBrace(same_line) ` {` (cc:3329, printc.cc:1593), startIndent/stopIndent per case (cc:3333/3348), labels at switch-body indent, statements +1 level, closing tagLine+`}` (cc:3350-3351); `switch(` with NO space per opBranchind tagOp+openParen (cc:586-587, matches the golden's `switch((int)pCVar10 ...)`)
observation.constant_format: MATCH: push_integer's val<=10 decimal boundary (printc.cc:1332) — `return 10;` vs `0x14`/`0x1e`/`0x28`/`0x3c` all identical (format_constant_value's boundary widened from <=9 to <=10 as part of this fix)

out_of_scope_gaps.summary: production try_rule_switch case labels are out-edge indices (case_values.push(vec![j])), never jumptable-recovered labels, and default_case is always None (checkSwitchSkips TODO) — the fixture bypasses try_rule_switch by hand-building the BlockSwitch, so these structurer/jumptable-recovery gaps do not surface here

implied/return-value folding in the full pipeline: doc_function-level emission still prints `uVar0 = 10; return uVar0;` where the oracle folds to `return 10;` (ActionReturnRecovery + implied varnolds) — outside the emission-layer scope of this fixture (funcdata test asserts structure, not the fold)
